Targeted therapeutic care

What Is Deep Tissue Massage?

Deep tissue massage uses slow, intentional techniques to address deeper muscle layers and connective tissue. It can be focused on a few problem areas or incorporated into a broader therapeutic session.

Potential benefits

May ease persistent muscle tension, support range of motion and help active bodies recover.

Who may benefit

People with recurring tightness, work-related strain or soreness from training may appreciate this focused approach.

What to expect

Your therapist discusses goals and pressure preferences first, then checks in so the work remains productive and comfortable.

Deep tissue massage in Bellevue

Every session at Fall Health Spa is adapted to how your body feels that day. Deep pressure is never the goal by itself; thoughtful, responsive care is. If a gentler approach better suits you, explore Swedish massage. Active guests may also consider sports massage, and eligible clients can learn about insurance massage therapy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does deep tissue massage have to hurt?

No. You may feel focused pressure, but treatment should stay within a tolerable range. Tell your therapist if you want the pressure adjusted.

How is deep tissue massage different from Swedish massage?

Deep tissue work is generally slower and more targeted, while Swedish massage typically uses broader, flowing techniques.

How long should I book?

The best length depends on how many areas need attention. Contact us if you would like help choosing a session time.

Can insurance cover deep tissue massage?

Some plans may include massage therapy benefits. Coverage and benefits vary by individual insurance plan. Please contact us to verify your massage therapy benefits.
